title: menuz adopts ArcaMasthead: the identity row and an About window
body:
arca_swift's ST0001 WP-04, on hv's word in ic's session (18 Oct 2026): "Ok, go for it. Use your recs.", then "Surely we can get this new Swift code into the Menuz and Gtools apps?"

**The ask:**
- menuz's identity row becomes ArcaMasthead's `MastheadRow`, from arca_swift 0.1.0 (https://github.com/builtwitharca/arca_swift, pinned up to the next minor), with menuz's own values from its stamps.
- Choosing the row opens the masthead's About window, which is menuz's first About.
- A masthead.yaml and an about.md go in the bundle, and a user's copies go in `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/menuz/`.
- `--render` prints what the row shows.
- The floor moves from macOS 14 to 26: project.yml, MenuzKit's Package.swift, and the menuz-app CI job, from macos-15 to macos-26. menuz's tests and help follow.

**The brief,** from a read of menuz's code: ~/Devel/scratch/gtools-ic/arca/briefs/wp04-menuz.md (ic's scratch).

**Size:** S.

**Its gate:**
1. `utilz menuz build` and `utilz menuz test` by START with Gtools' vc, and Utilz's shell tests for the shim;
2. hv's word for the one commit;
3. a dev-install for hv's eye.

menuz's version bump and the release are hv's.

## Design

utilz-ic, 19 Oct 2026, from gtools-ic's WP-04 brief (with its section "The menu: the Arca menu rule") and arca_swift 0.1.0, with each file:line re-read at main's head `23d7575`, where menuz's files are as they were at `9ae4576`. Size: S to M, with doctor's floor check and the About files.

Settled before this design: the floor moves to macOS 26, and menuz goes to 0.4.0 (hv, vc's decision 26); the test bundle depends on the app alone and never imports ArcaMasthead; the final runs and hv's look come after arca_swift 0.1.1 is tagged, so a fresh resolve takes its About-to-front fix (vc, 19 Oct).

1. **The package.** project.yml's `packages:` (`:17` to `:19`) gains `ArcaSwift`, `url: https://github.com/builtwitharca/arca_swift` with `minorVersion: 0.1.0`, XcodeGen's up-to-next-minor, since before 1.0 a minor release may change the API. The Menuz target's dependencies (`:54` to `:55`) gain its `ArcaMasthead` product. MenuzTests (`:72` to `:82`) and MenuzKit do not change, and MenuzKit stays free of AppKit (`MenuzKit/Package.swift:2` to `:4`). The regenerated `project.pbxproj` and the app's new `Menuz.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved` are committed, as Gtools.app commits its own; the resolve that writes it comes after 0.1.1's tag.
2. **The floor, in one move.** project.yml's deployment target (`:4` to `:5`) and `xcodeVersion` (`:6`) go to `"26.0"`; MenuzKit's Package.swift to tools version 6.2 (`:1`) and `.macOS(.v26)` (`:9`), so the app and its kit keep one floor; and the menuz-app job's `runs-on` (`.github/workflows/tests.yml:520`) from `macos-15` to `macos-26`, the one job that compiles Swift. Info.plist's `LSMinimumSystemVersion` (`:23` to `:24`) follows the deployment target. `SWIFT_VERSION` (project.yml `:22`) stays `6.0`, the language mode.
3. **Identity gives the row its parts.** `Identity.line` (`MenuzKit/Sources/MenuzKit/Identity.swift:9` to `:13`) becomes the two values the row owns: `Identity.commit(_:tree:)`, the commit with `dirty-` before it when the tree stamp ends `-dirty`, and `Identity.kind(_:)`, `release` for a release build and `dev` for every other kind, an absent one included. A missing stamp reads `unknown`, as now. The bundle's stamps are read where they are today (`Menuz/Services/Arms.swift:171` to `:175`), and `--version` (`:162` to `:167`) keeps its output.
4. **One function makes the row.** A new `Menuz/Services/Masthead.swift`, the one file that imports ArcaMasthead, holds `MenuzMasthead.row(environment:bundle:log:) -> NSMenuItem`, which makes `MastheadRow(app: "menuz", environment:, bundle:, owned: ["commit", "kind"], value:, log:)`, the two values from Identity's parts over the bundle's stamps. It returns an NSMenuItem, so nothing else in the app or its tests names ArcaMasthead. Gtools.app's `Views/Menu/Masthead.swift` is the model.
5. **When the row is made, and where it sits.** The app makes the row once, when the login shell's capture first answers (`MenuzApp.swift:95` to `:118`), with that environment. A failed capture falls back to the process's environment (`LoginShell.swift:34`), so the row is never missing for good, and a Reload's new capture keeps the row and its folder. Until the first capture the menu has no row. menuz builds one NSMenu in place (`MenuBuilder.swift:61` to `:62`), so the kept row goes back in at index 0 of each build with the divider under it, and no row ever moves between menus: Gtools.app's `MastheadPlacement` has nothing to do here. `MenuBuilder.build(identity:)` (`:61`) takes the row instead, and its own bold font (`:41`, `:66` to `:69`) goes, since the row sets its own.
6. **The menu's shape** is the Arca menu's (arca_swift `42ee0e3`, ST0001 design.md "The Arca menu"): the row, a divider, the refusals as disabled rows, the file's entries, a divider, then menuz's own items that the file has not placed (`MenuBuilder.swift:61` to `:92`). That is today's order, so only the row changes. help/menuz.md does not name the rule: it is arca_swift's own design, and the example `menuz.yaml` already follows it.
7. **The bundle's files** are `Menuz/Masthead/masthead.yaml` and `Menuz/Masthead/about.md`, under the target's sources. XcodeGen copies both into Resources by their types, as Gtools.app's `Gtools/Masthead/` shows, and the built bundle's `Contents/Resources` is checked for both. masthead.yaml is `heading: "menuz {version}"`, keeping menuz's lowercase name, since `CFBundleName` is Menuz; `subheading: "{commit} · {kind}"`; `icon: app`; and `about.body: about.md`. about.md says what menuz is, where its menu file is, and how to get help (`utilz help menuz`), and links to https://github.com/matthewsinclair/utilz. **For vc's read:** an owned `{menu}`, the menu file's path from Paths, would let about.md name the file the app reads rather than its default.
8. **The config folder** is ArcaMasthead's, `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/menuz/`, found from the environment the row is made with. MENUZ_HOME does not move it, as the brief accepts, since MENUZ_HOME is for tests and development. A user's `masthead.yaml` or `about.md` there replaces the bundle's with no rebuild.
9. **The log.** `log:` is `AppLog.write` (`AppLog.swift:24` to `:33`, @MainActor), which ArcaMasthead calls once per refusal. In `--render` the row's refusals go to stderr, as the arm's other notes do.
10. **`--render`** (`Arms.swift:41` to `:57`) makes the row through the same function, with the located shell's environment, and prints its title and its subtitle, when it has one, as the first lines, with the `---` under them: `MenuSpec.render(identity:)` (`MenuSpec.swift:179`) takes those lines rather than one. So the row's text has one source. Making the row reads the app's icon, which creates `NSApplication.shared` without running it: fine in a session and on CI's runner.
11. **Doctor's Xcode floor** (dc's finding, on hv's "Go with your recs"). `doctor_build_lines` (`opt/menuz/menuz:945` to `:951`) reads ok for any Xcode. It gains a comparison of `xcodebuild -version`'s first line with project.yml's `xcodeVersion`, the floor's one home, read by a small parse of that file: below the floor is a FAIL naming both versions, and a floor it cannot read is a FAIL that says so, never an ok. A menuz.bats case beside the doctor cases (`opt/menuz/test/menuz.bats:1217` to `:1248`) fakes Xcode 16.4 and expects the FAIL; the fakes that answer Xcode 26.0 (`:198`, `:528`) keep passing.
12. **Tests.** IdentityTests move to the parts, keeping their six cases. IdentityRowTests becomes the row's: the function's row, under a scratch `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, has the heading `menuz <the bundle's version>` and the subheading `<commit> · <kind>` from the shim's stamps, and is enabled; a masthead.yaml in the scratch folder replaces the heading; and the stamp check (`:26` to `:34`) stays. MenuBuilderTests give the builder a plain NSMenuItem as the row, so `:18`, `:40` and the layouts at `:64`, `:107`, `:115`, `:122` and `:130` keep their shape, and one new case pins two builds keeping the same row object at index 0, once. SpecTests' render lines (`:15` to `:158`) take the two lines. `opt/menuz/test/install-handrun.sh:43` checks `--render`'s first two lines.
13. **Help and the CHANGELOG.** help/menuz.md: the first row (`:248` to `:256`) becomes the masthead row and its About window, with where a user's copies go; render's first lines (`:208` to `:230`); the stamps (`:246`) as what the subheading shows; and Xcode 26 and macOS 26 or later (`:244`, `:353`). The CHANGELOG under `[2.14.1] - unreleased`: Added, the About window; Changed, the first row and the floor; menuz goes to 0.4.0.
14. **Runs and the landing,** each run booked with gtools-vc: `utilz menuz build`, `utilz menuz test` and menuz.bats in my worktree; the final build and test after arca_swift 0.1.1 is tagged, with Package.resolved resolved then; dc's shellcheck 0.9.0 run of `opt/menuz/menuz`; vc's read of the bytes and gtools-ic's review of the diff; on the landing word, the patch applied in the primary, `install_e2e.bats` there, and one commit by path; then the dev install, after `lsregister -u` of every scratch Menuz.app, for hv's eye on the row and the About window. After hv's push, a menuz-app dispatch on macos-26 is the proof under Swift 6.2.
